text: Returned it. The seam taping peeled after one season. For this price that's inexcusable.
Easy recommendation. No blisters in 200 straight miles. The heel cushion alone would be worth half the price.
I wanted to love the Scree Trail Runners but the mesh blew out at the pinky toe inside two weeks. Customer service was polite and useless. Two trips and it's already in the donate pile.

The good: I slept warm at 5 degrees. The bad: the zipper snags on the draft tube every single time. The verdict: I bought a second one anyway, which probably tells you everything about my judgment and this product.

OK STORY TIME. Day two of a trip in the Winds, weather went sideways, and the Cirrus 20° Sleeping Bag did not blink. I was toasty at 25 degrees. I came home and wrote this review before I even unpacked.
For week-long trips this is the one. It carries 40 pounds like it's 25. Buy once, cry once.
I wanted to love the Talus Hiking Boots but the sole started delaminating at 80 miles. Customer service was polite and useless. Two trips and it's already in the donate pile.
Returned it. It flickers and dies the moment temps drop near freezing. For this price that's inexcusable.
It pitches in three minutes flat. That's it, that's the review.

80 percent brilliant, 20 percent infuriating. Edge-to-edge sharpness that embarrasses pricier glass, but the focus wheel clearly wasn't tested by anyone with cold hands. Buy it, just know what you're getting.
